digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and protocol negotiation
propositions: Integration tests dedicate ~32.69 seconds to partial-clone fixtures that create >100MiB objects duplicated per xdist worker, consuming unnecessary setup time.
The filter:blob:none negotiation and missing-object oracles are size-independent and can be validated with small real Git protocol fixtures without the 100+ MiB object contrast.
Shared mutable Git servers across parallel workers risk race conditions and cross-worker contamination; each worker must own isolated ephemeral daemon, port, and temporary repository.

Large-object pack guards (>140 MiB incompressible payload) must remain in real Git protocol fixtures to prove filter behavior correctness, but can be confined to a single xdist worker via loadgroup isolation.
